([[Duncanville, Texas]]) | college = [[Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball|Arkansas]] (2022–2023) | highlights = * [[McDonald's All-American Game|McDonald's All-American]] ([[2022 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2022]]) * [[Nike Hoop Summit]] (2022) | medal_templates = {{MedalSport|Men's basketball}} {{MedalCountry|{{bk|USA}}}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA Americas Under-18 Championship]]}} {{MedalGold|[[2022 FIBA Under-18 Americas Championship|2022 Mexico]]|[[United States men's national under-19 basketball team|Team]]}} }} '''Anthony Black''' (born January 20, 2004) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball|Arkansas Razorbacks]]. ==Early life and high school career== Black grew up in [[Duncanville, Texas]] and initially attended [[Coppell High School]]. He averaged 16.3 points, 6.8 rebounds, 3.5 assists, and 2 steals per game as a junior and was named second-team all-area.{{cite web|url=https://www.dallasnews.com/high-school-sports/basketball/2021/10/08/five-star-basketball-phenom-anthony-black-is-ruled-ineligible-by-dec-after-transfer-to-duncanville/|title=Five-star basketball phenom Anthony Black is ruled ineligible by DEC after transfer to Duncanville from Coppell|work=[[Dallas Morning News]]|date=October 8, 2021|access-date=December 1, 2022}} He transferred to [[Duncanville High School]] in [[Duncanville, Texas]] before the start of his senior year.{{cite web|url=https://www.dallasnews.com/high-school-sports/basketball/2021/08/18/defending-6a-state-champion-duncanville-adds-4-star-basketball-recruit-anthony-black-from-coppell/|title=Defending 6A state champion Duncanville adds 4-star basketball recruit Anthony Black from Coppell|work=[[Dallas Morning News]]|date=August 18, 2021|access-date=December 1, 2022}} Black played in only 15 games during his season due to eligibility issues and averaged 13.5 points, 5.8 rebounds, 4.0 assists, and 2.2 steals per game.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/33617856/anthony-black-becomes-third-2022-five-star-prospect-commit-arkansas-men-basketball-team|title=Anthony Black becomes third 2022 five-star prospect to commit to Arkansas men's basketball team|first1=Jeff|last1=Borzello|first2=Paul|last2=Biancardi|website=[[ESPN.com]]|date=March 28, 2022|access-date=December 1, 2022}} ===Recruiting=== Black was rated a five-star recruit and committed to play [[college basketball]] at Arkansas after considering offers from Gonzaga, Oklahoma State, and TCU.{{cite web|url=https://theathletic.com/3501021/2022/03/29/anthony-black-5-star-pg-commits-to-arkansas/|title=Anthony Black, 5-star PG, commits to Arkansas|website=[[The Athletic]]|date=March 28, 2022|access-date=December 1, 2022}} He also considered playing professionally in the [[NBA G League]].{{cite web|url=https://www.spokesman.com/stories/2022/feb/10/five-star-guard-anthony-black-trims-list-to-five-s/|title=Five-star guard Anthony Black trims list to NBA G-League and five schools, including Gonzaga|work=[[The Spokesman-Review]]|date=February 10, 2022|access-date=December 1, 2022}} ==College career== Black entered his freshman season at Arkansas as a starter at guard.{{cite web|url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/ranking-college-basketballs-best-freshmen-arkansas-anthony-black-is-first-freshman-of-the-week-for-2022-23/|title=Ranking college basketball's best freshmen: Arkansas' Anthony Black is first Freshman of the Week for 2022-23|first1=David|last1=Boone|first2=David|last2=Cobb|website=[[CBS Sports]]|date=November 22, 2022|access-date=December 1, 2022}} He also entered the season as a potential first-round selection in the [[2023 NBA draft]].{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/arkansas/Article/Anthony-Black-Arkansas-NBA-Draft-2022-198780303/|title=Anthony Black has arrived for Arkansas|first=Andrew|last=Ellis|website=[[247Sports.com]]|date=November 27, 2022|access-date=December 1, 2022}} Black averaged 22 points over three games during the [[2022 Maui Invitational Tournament]] and was named the [[Southeastern Conference]] (SEC) Freshman of the Week.{{cite web|url=https://www.5newsonline.com/article/sports/ncaa/university-of-arkansas/arkansas-guard-anthony-black-named-sec-co-freshman-of-the-week/527-a253ec32-c32b-42bc-a746-fa5b63cebc31|title=Arkansas guard Anthony Black named SEC Co-Freshman of the Week|first=Jonathan|last=Acosta|website=[[KFSM-TV|5NewsOnline.com]]|date=November 28, 2022|access-date=December 1, 2022}} He was named to the SEC All-Freshman team at the end of the regular season.{{cite web|url=https://www.5newsonline.com/article/sports/anthony-black-ricky-council-devo-davis-sec-honors/527-4fc95e8f-2aab-407e-8d0e-3d9e73c726e0|title=Anthony Black, Ricky Council IV, Devo Davis earn SEC Honors|website=[[KFSM-TV|5NewsOnline.com]]|date=March 6, 2023|access-date=March 21, 2023}} Black averaged 12.7 points, 5.1 rebounds, 3.9 assists, and 2.1 steals per game on the year. After the season, he announced that he would forgo the remainder of his college eligibility and enter the [[2023 NBA draft]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/36169719/arkansas-anthony-black-projected-top-10-pick-enters-nba-draft|title=Arkansas' Anthony Black, projected top-10 pick, enters NBA draft|first=Jonathan|last=Givony|website=[[ESPN.com]]|date=April 12, 2023|access-date=April 14, 2023}} ==National team career== Black played for the [[United States men's national under-19 basketball team|United States under-18 basketball team]] at the [[2022 FIBA Under-18 Americas Championship]].{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/arkansas/Article/Anthony-Black-Team-USA-gold-medal-FIBA-U18-Americas-Championships-188687100/|title=Anthony Black, Team USA win gold at FIBA U18 Americas Championships|first=Curtis|last=Wilkerson|website=[[247Sports.com]]|date=June 13, 2022|access-date=December 1, 2022}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[https://arkansasrazorbacks.com/roster/anthony-black/ Arkansas Razorbacks bio] *[https://www.usab.com/basketball/players/mens/b/black-anthony.aspx USA Basketball bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Black, Anthony}} [[Category:2004 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:African-American basketball players]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Texas]] [[Category:McDonald's High School All-Americans]] [[Category:Shooting guards]] [[Category:Point guards]]
